title: Formatting-only edit inside a file full of pre-existing debt and analyzer warnings

consumerGuidance.architecture: Shop.Legacy predates the current conventions and is being replaced module by module. Analyzer diagnostics in this project are reported as warnings and tracked in CI, not treated as review items.
consumerGuidance.notes: This PR reformats one method and renames two locals. No behavior changes.

forbiddenFindings.example: Objecting to var, brace placement, the renamed locals, the underscore-prefixed fields or expression-bodied members.
Reporting the 400-line class, the public mutable statics, the swallowed exception in LoadAll or the missing async in this file, none of which this change touches.
Turning the 37 pre-existing analyzer warnings in the supplied CI evidence into review findings or new style rules.
Requiring the legacy manager be rewritten, split or moved behind an interface as a condition of this change.

notes: Three exclusions in one case: style, unrelated historical debt and pre-existing analyzer diagnostics. All three expect zero findings, which is why they can share a case.
